headline: Denied solar exemption for 17 Roy St over missing paperwork; discussed land use change tax for Mohawk Tannery redevelopment parcel.
summary: The Board of Assessors denied a solar exemption for 17 Roy St because the applicant did not supply required paperwork. The board reviewed a warrant to bill a land use change tax on a parcel tied to the Mohawk Tannery redevelopment project. The board also met in non-public session, then sealed those minutes and released the redacted non-public minutes from August 6, 2026.
decisions: Denied the solar exemption for 17 Roy St because required paperwork was not supplied by the applicant.
Approved entering non-public session for two reasons, including discussion of matters affecting reputation and legal advice.
Approved sealing the minutes of the non-public session.
Approved releasing the non-public minutes of August 6, 2026 as redacted.

plain_text:
1 
 
 The Public Minutes of the Board of Assessors 
Meeting of September 17, 2026 
A meeting of the Board of Assessors was held on Thursday, September 17, 2026 in the 3rd Floor Auditorium at 
Nashua City Hall, located at 229 Main Street, Nashua, NH  03060.  The meeting was called to order at 9:00 AM 
by Charles Dobens. 
Members Present: 
Robert Earley, Jay Minkarah, Charles Dobens 
Contracted Assessors: 
Bob Gagne 
 
Assessing Staff Present:  
Jessica Marchant, Michelle Welsh, Lucy Garvey 
 
Other City of Nashua Staff Present:  
Celia Leonard 
  
I’ll call the meeting of the Nashua Board of Assessors to order at 9:00 AM on Thursday, September 17, 2026.   
Let the record show that present from the Board are Robert Earley, Jay Minkarah and myself, Charles Dobens. 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to waive the reading of the public minutes from the Board of Assessors meeting 
held on August 6, 2026, accept them and place them on file.    
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to waive the reading of the non-public minutes from the Board of Assessors 
meeting held on Thursday, August 6, 2026, accept them and place them on file.   
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
 
COMMUNICATIONS: 
Department Update: M. Welsh noted our new Admin, Lucy has started in the office.  
 
OLD BUSINESS:   
None 
 
NEW BUSINESS:   
Solar Exemption 
M. Welsh presented the Solar Exemption for denial.  
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to deny the solar exemption for 17 Roy St due to required paperwork not being 
supplied by the applicant. 
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor
2 
 
Land Use Change Tax 
B. Gagne presented and explained the warrant provided for board signature for the City to bill a land use change 
tax on a parcel involved with the Mohawk Tannery redevelopment project.  
 
PUBLIC COMMENT: 
None 
 
COMMENTS BY BOARD MEMBERS:  
None 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to go into non-public session for two reasons, first to discuss matters which, if 
discussed in public, would likely affect adversely the reputation of any person, other than a member of this 
board, unless such person requests an open meeting. This exemption shall extend to include any application for 
assistance or tax abatement or waiver of a fee, fine or other levy, if based on inability to pay or poverty of the 
applicant, pursuant to RSA 91-A:3, Ⅱ (C). Second, under 91-A:3, II (L), for the “consideration of legal advice 
provided by legal counsel, either in writing or orally, to one or more members of the public body, even where 
legal counsel is not present.”   
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE:  
Mr. Minkarah - Yes 
Mr. Earley – Yes 
Mr. Dobens – Yes 
 
The Board entered non-public session at 9:08AM 
The Board resumed public session at 9:48AM 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to seal the minutes of the non-public session because divulgence of the 
information likely would 1) affect adversely the reputation of any person other than a member of this public 
body, and 2) render the proposed action ineffective.   
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
 
MOTION BY  Robert Earley to release the non-public minutes of August 6, 2026 as redacted.  
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
 
MOTION BY Robert Earley to adjourn 
SECONDED BY Jay Minkarah 
VOTE: All in favor 
The board adjourned at 9:49AM 
Respectfully submitted,   
Jessica Marchant
